name.ja: HG 1/72 メイレスジョウガン

description.ja: 「境界戦機」よりレジスタンスの鉄塚ガシンが搭乗するI-LeS(自律思考型AI)を搭載したAMAIM(アメイン)「ジョウガン」をHGで立体化。
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki ", the AMAIM " Jougan" equipped with I-LeS (autonomous thinking AI), piloted by Gasin Tetsuzuka of the Resistance, is made into a three-dimensional HG.

description.ja: ■商品化に於いてKEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる可動構造の検証を経て立体化されたAMAIM(アメイン)。
description.en: • AMAIM was made into a three-dimensional product after verification of its movable structure by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN.

description.ja: ■リアアーマーにはアウトリガー展開状態をパーツの差し替えで再現。カカト部分も展開し、射撃ポーズの再現が可能。
description.en: • The outrigger deployment state is reproduced on the rear armor by replacing parts. The heel part can also be expanded to recreate shooting poses.

description.ja: ■120mm二連装狙撃砲が付属。銃床パーツはスライド式のストックで射撃ポーズを再現。
description.en: • 120mm dual sniper gun included. The gun stock part reproduces the shooting pose with a sliding stock.

description.ja: ■左肩シールド裏への戦闘短刀の収納が可能。
description.en: • A combat dagger can be stored on the back of the left shoulder seal.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 平手（左右）、武器持ち手(左右)、ライフル持ち手(右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Open hand (left and right), weapon handle (left and right), rifle handle (right)

accessories.ja: リアアーマー展開用パーツ×１
